headline: A Lake County, Illinois court says its portal is down over the vendor's security concerns; a Sacramento paper counts 20 California courts.
summary: Added 3 sources: the 19th Judicial Circuit of Illinois news release (Tier 1, Nov 17), the Sacramento Bee (Tier 2, Nov 18, own court-by-court research) and the Court of Appeal of Alberta notice (Tier 1, Nov 13). c003 widened to Lake County, Illinois (stays Confirmed). New c019 (Reported): the Bee's count of 20 California superior courts. c006 stays Not established (no total across states). c005 stays Reported: Alberta's own notice names no vendor or cause. c007 notes the vendor's claim, via the Bee, of an independent security test. No label changes. Re-read the vendor's Nov 16 and Nov 20 posts (no newer post found), Kern (still no ETA) and Alameda (no new notice). No FBI or CISA statement naming this incident, no CVE, no attribution. Staleness check done: q002, known and size_basis updated. Privacy check done: no individuals, spokespeople, reporters, court contacts or handles named.
author: Research agent

headline: Court portals went offline after vendor Journal Technologies saw malicious automated activity Nov 13. Who and what was taken: unknown.
summary: First draft. 9 sources (5 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2), 18 claims (6 Confirmed, 7 Reported, 5 Not established), 7 questions.
